answer: Vertex bond registry: every new agent identity must lock 4,000 POA in the Vertex registry for eight full epochs before it can earn anything, and the bond is slashed entirely if the identity is proven part of a Sybil cluster. A Whisper attestation log records each identity's completed work, and a Juniper audit queue samples 5 percent of new identities per epoch for proof-of-work checks. Faking 500 agents means locking 2,000,000 POA for eight epochs with a real chance of losing it all, while one honest agent risks a single 4,000 POA bond once.
